allow: Bash(cd /tmp/ro && echo "sldId entries referenced in presentation:"; grep -o '<p:sldId ' x/ppt/presentation.xml | wc -l *)

PowerShell($p = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty OwningProcess; if \($p\) { Stop-Process -Id $p -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Output "freed 3000 \(was PID $p\)" } else { Write-Output "3000 free" })

PowerShell($ok=$false; for\($i=0;$i -lt 40;$i++\){ try { $r=Invoke-WebRequest -Uri http://localhost:3000 -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 3; if\($r.StatusCode -eq 200\){ $ok=$true; break } } catch {} Start-Sleep -Seconds 1 }; if\($ok\){ Write-Output "READY: http://localhost:3000" } else { Write-Output "not ready"; Get-Content tmp/dev.log -Tail 15 })
